movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.title: Les Parapluies de Cherbourg
movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.plot: A young umbrella-shop girl and her mechanic lover are separated when he is drafted to Algeria, their romance unfolding in sung-through color.
movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.reason: Its sung-through romantic drama is a bold tonal shift that tests your tolerance for stylized emotion within the channel.

movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.title: Bande à part
movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.plot: Two young men and a woman plot a clumsy robbery of her aunt's villa in a playful, rebellious caper.
movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.reason: Its mix of romance, thriller, and Nouvelle Vague irreverence is mainstream yet risky — perfect to gauge your response to Godard's style.

movie-recs-prefetch-queue:1b90b4b2-25c9-.reason: A psychologically complex drama-romance that could fit your taste for layered, provocative storytelling.
